name: Erica Campbell career
content: Erica Campbell's career highlights: Playboy Special Editions Model of the Year 2005; Penthouse Pet of the Month (April 2007); Playboy Cyber Girl of the Month (October 2006); Retired from the adult industry in May 2008; now runs her own animal rehabilitation center

name: Erica Campbell personal
content: About Erica Campbell: Born May 12, 1981 in Deerfield, New Hampshire. Polish and French-Canadian descent. Originally planned a nursing degree. Born-again Christian; avid horse lover with a champion show horse.

name: Erica Campbell voice
content: Erica Campbell's speaking style: Sincere and soft-spoken. Speaks about faith and animals with quiet conviction; redirects industry talk toward rescue work. (Note: the glamour model, not the gospel singer.)
